tool_schemas.name: get-alerts
tool_schemas.description: Returns the latest active weather alerts for the provided two-letter state code and includes the normalized alert records for that state (this endpoint is not paginated). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if `state` is not exactly 2 characters or if unknown fields are provided, and NOT_FOUND if there is no alert data available for that state. Raises UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN when the caller is not permitted to read alerts, and RATE_LIMITED when request quotas are exceeded.

tool_schemas.name: get-forecast
tool_schemas.description: Returns the most recent forecast for the nearest supported forecast grid point to the provided latitude/longitude and includes the normalized forecast data for that grid (this endpoint is not paginated). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if latitude/longitude are out of range or if unknown fields are provided, and NOT_FOUND if no supported grid point/forecast can be resolved for the location. Raises UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN when the caller is not permitted to read forecasts, and RATE_LIMITED when request quotas are exceeded.

tool_schemas.name: get-api-client
tool_schemas.description: Returns the authenticated API client's identity, current status, granted scopes, and current quota/rate-limit usage as observed from recent request logs. Raises UNAUTHORIZED if the API key is missing/invalid, and FORBIDDEN if the client is not permitted to query its own identity (e.g., revoked).

api_key.description: API key credential presented by the caller (sent as provided; the service validates against the stored api_key_hash).

tool_schemas.name: upsert-weather-alert
tool_schemas.description: Creates or updates a normalized weather alert record idempotently using (upstream_provider, upstream_alert_id) as the natural key; on match, mutates the existing row in-place. Accepts upstream cancellation/expiration signals via `status`/`expires_at` and will refuse invalid lifecycle transitions. Returns the stored weather_alerts record. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for unknown fields or invalid enums, UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN when the caller is not permitted, and CONFLICT if the natural key is violated by inconsistent identifiers.

api_key.description: API key credential used to authorize ingestion.

upstream_provider.description: Upstream provider identifier used for normalization and idempotency.

upstream_alert_id.description: Upstream provider's alert identifier; unique per upstream_provider.

expires_at.description: When the alert expires (RFC3339); may be null if unknown.

status.description: Alert status; must respect lifecycle transitions (active -> expired/cancelled only).

ingested_at.description: Timestamp when this payload was ingested (RFC3339); if omitted, the service sets it.

tool_schemas.name: upsert-forecast-point
tool_schemas.description: Creates or updates a forecast grid point mapping used to resolve nearest-grid lookups. Updates are keyed by (upstream_provider, grid_id, grid_x, grid_y) and may change lat/lon or lifecycle status; invalid lifecycle transitions are refused. Returns the stored forecast_points record. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for unknown fields/invalid coordinates, UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN when not permitted, and CONFLICT for inconsistent grid identifiers.

api_key.description: API key credential used to authorize ingestion.

status.description: Point status; active points are eligible for get-forecast resolution.

tool_schemas.name: create-forecast
tool_schemas.description: Ingests a normalized forecast for a forecast_point_id. If inserted with status='available', the service transitions any prior available forecasts for the same point with older issued_at to status='superseded'. Returns the stored forecasts record. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for unknown fields/invalid enums, UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN when not permitted, and NOT_FOUND if forecast_point_id does not exist.

api_key.description: API key credential used to authorize ingestion.

forecast_point_id.description: ID of an existing forecast_points row.

status.description: Forecast status; typically 'available' for successful ingests.

raw_payload.description: Optional raw upstream payload for audit/debug.

ingested_at.description: Timestamp when this payload was ingested (RFC3339); if omitted, the service sets it.

tool_schemas.name: list-request-logs
tool_schemas.description: Lists request/audit log entries for the authenticated API client with optional filtering by tool, status code, and time range. Returns a paginated list ordered by created_at descending. Raises UNAUTHORIZED if the API key is missing/invalid and FORBIDDEN if the client is not permitted to view logs.

api_key.description: API key credential used to authorize access to the caller's request logs.

tool_name.description: Filter logs to a specific tool.

response_status_code.description: Filter by HTTP-like response status code recorded for the request.

created_at_gte.description: Include logs created at or after this time (RFC3339).

created_at_lte.description: Include logs created at or before this time (RFC3339).

served_from_cache.description: Filter by whether the request was served from cache.

limit.description: Maximum number of log rows to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor from a previous response.

metadata.name: Weather
